text:
Maya (marketing): quick ask for @eng-runtime — we need a sanitized rerun pack for the launch post. target: the 7B quantized profile we showed in the deck. Can you run a reproduceable suite and drop raw latency CSVs + warmup traces + a short note on methodology?

Maya (marketing): specifics we need: model variant name, quant flags, token lengths (coldstart vs steady), batch sizes, and the exact runner command used. Also include percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and a small explanation of any outliers.

Kai (marketing-ops): do you want the sample prompts included or just anonymized latencies?

Maya (marketing): anonymized latencies + one example prompt per cohort (no PII). Cohorts: interactive demo (250 queries), batch embed (1000 short texts), long-context tail (50 queries @ 2048 tokens). For the launch narrative we mostly care about interactive demo numbers.

Olivia (eng-runtime): we can run this in staging. A few clarifying q's: 1) exact model tag? (there are two q8 candidates) 2) should we measure coldstart as first request after container spin-up or after KV cache wiped? 3) do you want quantized kernels pinned?

Maya (marketing): use "redwood-7b-q8-v2" tag (the one in the model catalog). Coldstart = first request after a 30s idle; include both coldstart and steady-state. Pin kernels if that gives stable numbers — just call out what you pinned.

Sandeep (runtime): noted. We'll run:
```
./bench-runner --model redwood-7b-q8-v2 --quant q8 --batch-sizes 1,4 --seq-lens 32,512,2048 --cohorts interactive,batch,longtail --warmup 100 --requests 250 --output csv --trace warmup_trace.json
```
I'll also capture kernel selection and GPU mem stats. Expect ~5-8 hours to run full sweep on staging dpool.

Olivia (eng-runtime): scheduling now. We'll anonymize payloads and attach a README.md with exact commands and env vars. bench-bot: created job #RERUN-7623 and scheduled on staging-dpool-3, ETA 7h.

bench-bot: job RERUN-7623 accepted, estimated runtime 7h, artifacts will be uploaded to /artifacts/reruns/4476543210/ when complete.

Maya (marketing): amazing — can you please try to have raw CSV + short methodology note by EOD Thursday? marketing needs to draft the launch post and want to call out p95 latency + warmup behavior. :pray:

Sandeep (runtime): will do. If anything looks off (high tail or jitter) we'll thumbs-up or flag for a rerun with a longer warmup.

Kai (marketing-ops): tagging for visibility: @Olivia @Sandeep — if you hit blockers around dataset sanitization, we can provide a scrubbed example payload set.

Olivia (eng-runtime): thanks — will ping if we need the scrubbed set. Otherwise we'll upload artifacts to the job folder and post here when ready.

Maya (marketing): ideal: compressed CSV + short writeup (3-4 bullet points) and a 1-line suggested caption for the launch post referencing p95/p50 and quantized savings.

Sandeep (runtime): copied. I'll post progress updates in this thread when jobs finish or if we need a quick rerun.

Maya (marketing): appreciated, team.
